name: What is a punch list in construction and why is it important?

mainEntity.name: What is a punch list in construction and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: A punch list is a document generated at the end of a construction project detailing items that need to be corrected or completed before final project acceptance. It typically includes minor deficiencies, cosmetic imperfections, or incomplete installations identified during a walkthrough. Addressing these items ensures the final product meets the agreed-upon quality standards and client expectations, preventing future disputes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A punch list details items needing correction or completion before final project acceptance, ensuring quality and client satisfaction.
